findings.evidence: Mathlib precedent: `Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/WithZero.lean:319 withZeroUnitsEquiv_symm_apply_coe`, `Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subsemiring/Basic.lean:895 subsemiringMap_symm_apply_coe`, `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Affine/Isometry.lean:674 ofTop_symm_apply_coe`. The sibling `integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv_apply` (line 140) has no coercion and is correctly named.
findings.fix: Rename to `integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv_symm_apply_coe`, matching Mathlib's convention for `↑(e.symm x) = …`.
findings.issue: `integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv_symm_apply` states `((equiv K S).symm P : HeightOneSpectrum R) = integerPrimeUnder K S P`, i.e. an equality of the *coercion* out of the subtype, not of `(equiv K S).symm P` itself. The name advertises the stronger subtype-level statement.

findings.evidence: Mathlib confines `intValuationDef_*` to the three unfolding lemmas (AdicValuation.lean:87,91,94) and states all API lemmas on `intValuation` (`intValuation_if_neg`:182, `intValuation_le_pow_iff_mem`:253); the `algebraMap`-argument convention is `valuation_of_algebraMap`:341 and `adicAbv_of_algebraMap`:1085. TauCeti's only other user of this API uses `intValuation` throughout (TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor/Dedekind/Basic.lean:148-218); this lemma is the sole `intValuationDef` occurrence in the repo.
findings.fix: Rename to `intValuation_integerPrimeOverOfNotMem_of_algebraMap` and state it as `(integerPrimeOverOfNotMem K S hv).intValuation (algebraMap R (S.integer K) a) = v.intValuation a` (`intValuation_apply` is `rfl`).
findings.issue: `intValuationDef_integerPrimeOverOfNotMem` names the unbundled internal definition `intValuationDef` rather than the API-level `intValuation`, and omits `of_algebraMap` although the argument is `algebraMap R (S.integer K) a`, so the name reads as a general statement about the valuation at the prime above `v`.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn "primeOfNotMem\|primeBelow\|heightOneSpectrumEquiv\|integer_comap_map_asIdeal" --include=*.lean .` in ./code returns no matches (the code names capitalise as `PrimeOverOfNotMem` / `HeightOneSpectrumEquiv`, so no substring hit either).
findings.fix: Update the description to the names actually introduced, so the API can be found by the names the PR advertises.
findings.issue: The PR description names declarations that do not exist at the head: `primeOfNotMem`, `primeBelow`, `heightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `valuation_heightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `integer_comap_map_asIdeal`. The code has `integerPrimeOverOfNotMem`, `integerPrimeUnder`, `integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `valuation_integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `integer_comap_map_pow`.

summary: Names mostly follow the `integer_*` family already established in SInteger/Basic.lean and Mathlib's `under`/`over` terminology, but two names misdescribe their statements: a simp lemma stated on the internal `intValuationDef` with the `algebraMap` argument unnamed, and a `_symm_apply` lemma whose LHS is actually a coercion. The PR description also cites five declaration names that do not exist in the diff.
